The 5 of us spent the next 10 to 20 minutes trying to get a game going. The Online Multiplayer refused to load, regardless of our internet connections and persistence. The Solo Queue option (where you play against AI) failed to load as well. One of my friends sat for 10 minutes with the solo game loading. And loading. And loading. Finally, we all realized what we had to do. 

In unison, we pressed the sacred combination of keys that generations of gamers before us were forced to use. Control+Alt+Delete. Task Manager. End Task. 

Now, I'm here. Writing this review. I didn't come close to expressing the sheer magnitude of emotions I am feeling at this moment. I would not wish this experience upon my worst enemy. Nobody should be forced to go through this.

My disappointment is immeasurable,
and my day is ruined.
